title: Kunneth injectivity for the first cohomology of a product
statement: Let $k$ be a field [def-weil-field], and let $X$ and $Y$ be proper schemes over $k$ [def-weil-proper-morphism] [def-weil-scheme-over-base] with $H^0(X,\mathcal O_X)=k$ and $H^0(Y,\mathcal O_Y)=k$. For $k$-rational points [def-pc-rational-point] $x\in X(k)$ and $y\in Y(k)$, the homomorphism $H^1(X \times_k Y,\mathcal O_{X \times_k Y}) \to H^1(X,\mathcal O_X) \oplus H^1(Y,\mathcal O_Y)$ given by pullback along the slices $(1,y):X\to X\times_kY$ and $(x,1):Y\to X\times_kY$ is injective.

source.place: Varieties, Lemma varieties-lemma-kunneth, Tag 0BED, applied in degree 1 to O_X and O_Y

proof.text: Express each product H1 class as a sum of the two projection pullbacks, using the existence-only spanning theorem. This keeps the Kunneth route and the scalar-global-function hypotheses.

Use the identity and composition laws for structure-sheaf cohomology pullback and the pullback.lift projection equations. Pulling the X projection back to the X slice is the identity, and similarly for Y. The cross composites are f followed by y and g followed by x. Their cohomology maps factor through H1(Spec k,O)=0, obtained from affine-scheme vanishing applied to the quasi-coherent unit sheaf. Its underlying abelian cohomology is definitionally the structureSheafAb cohomology.

Apply the proved private additive-group lemma injective_pair_of_spanning. If two classes have equal slice pairs, both slices kill their difference c-d. Express c-d=p_X^*a+p_Y^*b using spanning. Additivity and the four composite calculations show that its X slice is a and its Y slice is b, so a=b=0. Projection pullbacks preserve zero, hence c-d=0 and c=d.

lean.statement: theorem picard_h1_product_injective (k : Type u) [Field k] (X Y : Scheme.{u}) [X.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [Y.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsProper (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] [IsProper (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k))] (hX : Function.Bijective (globalSectionsRingHom k (X := X))) (hY : Function.Bijective (globalSectionsRingHom k (X := Y))) (x : (X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).fieldPoints k) (y : (Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)).fieldPoints k) : let f := X ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k) let g := Y ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k) let iX : X ⟶ pullback f g := pullback.lift (𝟙 X) (f ≫ y.1) (by dsimp only [f, g] rw [Category.id_comp, Category.assoc, y.2] simp) let iY : Y ⟶ pullback f g := pullback.lift (g ≫ x.1) (𝟙 Y) (by dsimp only [f, g] rw [Category.id_comp, Category.assoc, x.2] simp) Function.Injective ((structureSheafCohomologyPullback iX 1).prod (structureSheafCohomologyPullback iY 1))

reviewed_lean.note: k Field; X,Y Over Spec k with IsProper on X↘/Y↘; H0=k as bijective globalSectionsRingHom; x,y fieldPoints (sections); X×_kY = pullback f g; iX=lift(𝟙,f≫y), iY=lift(g≫x,𝟙) = (1,y),(x,1); H1 = Sheaf.H of O_ab on Zariski site, pullback = Ext map via exact f^{-1}, ℤ comparison, adjoint of f.c; conclusion Injective of AddMonoidHom.prod
